# 1 Chronicles Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 376r–376v

---

**10:1** And-the-Pelishtim fought against-Yisra'el, and-fled the-men of-Yisra'el from-before the-Pelishtim, and-fell slain on-Mount Gilboa. **10:2** And-pursued the-Pelishtim after Sha'ul and-after his-sons, and-struck-down the-Pelishtim Yonatan and-Avinadav and-Malki-Shu'a, the-sons of-Sha'ul. **10:3** And-was-heavy the-battle against Sha'ul, and-found-him the-shooters [morim] with-the-bow, and-he-was-wounded [vayachal] from the-shooters.

**10:4** And-said Sha'ul to his-armor-bearer [nosei khelav]: Draw your-sword and-thrust-me-through with-it, lest they-come, these the-uncircumcised [arelim], and-deal-shamefully [vehit'alelu] with-me. And-not was-willing his-armor-bearer, for he-feared greatly. And-took Sha'ul the-sword and-fell upon-it. **10:5** And-saw his-armor-bearer that was-dead Sha'ul, and-fell — also he — upon the-sword and-died.

**10:6** And-died Sha'ul and-three of-his-sons, and-all his-house — together they-died. **10:7** And-saw every-man of-Yisra'el who [was] in-the-valley that they-had-fled and-that had-died Sha'ul and-his-sons, and-they-abandoned their-cities and-fled, and-came the-Pelishtim and-dwelt in-them.

**10:8** And-it-was on-the-next-day, and-came the-Pelishtim to-strip the-slain, and-they-found Sha'ul and-his-sons fallen on-Mount Gilboa. **10:9** And-they-stripped-him, and-took his-head and-his-armor, and-sent [vayeshalchu] into-the-land of-the-Pelishtim all-around to-bring-news [levasseir] [to] their-idols [atsabbeyhem] and-the-people. **10:10** And-they-put his-armor in-the-house of-their-gods [eloheyhem], and-his-skull [gulgolto] they-fastened in-the-house of-Dagon.

**10:11** And-heard all Yavesh-Gil'ad all that the-Pelishtim had-done to-Sha'ul. **10:12** And-rose every man of-valor [ish chayil] and-took the-body of-Sha'ul and-the-bodies of-his-sons and-brought-them to-Yavesh, and-buried their-bones under the-oak [ha-elah] in-Yavesh, and-fasted seven days.

**10:13** And-died Sha'ul because-of-his-treachery [ma'alo] which he-committed-treachery [ma'al] against-YHWH, against the-word of-YHWH which he-did-not keep, and-also for-inquiring [lish'ol] of a-medium [ov] to-seek [lidrosh]. **10:14** And-not did-he-inquire [darash] of-YHWH, and-he-killed-him, and-turned the-kingdom to-David son of-Yishay.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "all his house":** The Chronicler writes "all his house together they died" — a significant change from 1 Samuel 31:6 ("his armor-bearer and all his men"). The Chronicler emphasizes the totality of Saul's dynastic collapse, not merely battlefield casualties.

**v.9 — atsabbeyhem:** "Their idols" — from *atsav* (shaped image). The Chronicler uses this contemptuous term. 1 Samuel 31:9 has "the house of their idols" differently framed.

**v.10 — gulgolto:** "His skull" — the Chronicler specifies the skull fastened in the temple of Dagon. 1 Samuel 31:10 has the whole body fastened to the wall of Beth-shan. The Chronicler reshapes the narrative.

**v.13-14 — ma'al:** The key theological term — *ma'al* (treachery/unfaithfulness against the sacred). The Chronicler's verdict is absent from 1 Samuel. The wordplay on *lish'ol* (to inquire) and *Sha'ul* is unmistakable — Saul's very name is bound to the act that condemned him.

*— EMET*
